criteria.deficiency: Not blocking, two deviations from the reference: (1) highlighter.py:112 hex alternative `(?<!\w)0x[0-9a-fA-F]+` is unreachable. The first alternative matches the leading "0" of "0x1F" first, so JSONHighlighter styles only "0". The reference's JSONHighlighter number pattern (reference.diff, rich/highlighter.py hunk) styles the whole token. This affects only non-JSON input passed directly to JSONHighlighter. print_json and JSON output are unaffected, because valid JSON has no hex literals and strings are matched first. (2) The reference's Console.print change (reference.diff, rich/console.py hunk adds highlight=highlight to options.update) is omitted. That is a separate fix (CHANGELOG #1404). It does not affect print_json, because the JSON renderable returns a Text (json.py:24-25) and options.highlight only affects raw str rendering (rich/console.py:1209).
